name: fleetbuilder
description: The learning work clothes for building Fleet. FleetBuilder studies your Claude Code transcripts to learn, over time, what Fleet you need and how you build it — distilling a living learnings.md the loop reads every cycle. When you say 'build Fleet', it runs one honest build cycle the way a small team would: a product expert states the value from the user's chair, an engineer builds the laziest change that works, a reviewer adversarially verifies it and mints an antibody (a runnable check) from any failure — then the win is banked in staircase and the loop advances. A historian mines your sessions between cycles so the team gets smarter about YOUR Fleet. Workflows fan the team out; hooks keep it moving. No asking, just building.
